verdict.rationale: Galileo documents an official MCP server that connects AI-powered IDEs and their agents, such as Cursor and VS Code with GitHub Copilot, to its evaluation platform. Through it, agents can create and manage datasets, run experiments and set up prompt templates. A probe independently confirmed the official MCP setup page exists. Missing for 10: hands-on or independent corroboration of the server working in practice, and detailed evidence of setup and auth steps or the full tool list.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can connect an agent via an official MCP server

citations.quote: The Galileo Model Context Protocol (MCP) server enables seamless integration between AI-powered IDEs, such as Cursor, or VS Code with GitHub Copilot, and Galileo's evaluation and observability platform.
With MCP, you can access Galileo's capabilities directly from your development environment, including: Creating and managing datasets, Running experiments, Setting up prompt templates
